description:
Qualifications 


* Ability to understand end-user needs and user experience 

* Is an independent worker and proactively seeks to innovate 

* Demonstrated problem solving and analytical skills 

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills 

* Proven results oriented person with a delivery and quality focus 

* Ability to mentor and bring junior developers to your level and skill 

* Openness to learn new skills and techniques. 

* Possesses knowledge of the following applications and tools: 


* Web development languages (e.g. HTML, CSS, JavaScript) 

* Experience with CSS pre-processors (less, SASS) 

* Experience with one or more server side languages, especially Python or Java 

* Experience with common template frameworks (django, JSP) 

* Working knowledge of JavaScript beyond common web application libraries (jQuery, lodash) 

* Working knowledge of JavaScript MVC frameworks (Backbone, AngularJS, React.js) 

* Solid knowledge on web service integration (SOAP, REST, JSON, XML) 

* Working knowledge of mobile apps (Android, iOS) 

* Should possess knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Axure, Balasmic, etc. 

* Should be capable of web application analysis and performance optimization using industry standard best practices 

* BS in Computer Science or related field.


 SOAP, REST, JSON, XML,Agile, Analysis, Analytical Skills,JavaScript, jQuery, JSP
